Français courant ; anglais professionnel apprécié.   Ce que nous vous offrons : Un poste transversal avec un impact direct sur la visibilité et le développement de la FER Genève. jobs.title: External Service Employee "Gastronomy & Catering" (m/f/d) Geneva Region
jobs.description: Pacovis is a solid Swiss company, owner-managed, that has believed in the future for 90 years. As a reliable service provider for production and supply processes in the catering and food sector, we are enthusiastic about finding solutions for our clients. A contagious enthusiasm. Perhaps you too? As part of a planned long-term succession, we are seeking your support. As a   External Service Employee "Gastronomy & Catering" (m/f/d) Geneva Region You strengthen our sales team, enrich our company with joy, drive and competence, and live your personal and professional happiness. In this role, you are responsible for the sales area assigned to you and manage it independently. We are explicitly not looking for a classic "representative." You engage with your clients as an equal and are a competent contact, a problem solver and a source of ideas for our clients. This is a role in which you will thrive and for which we grant you the necessary time. Your responsibilities You accompany and advise our clients comprehensively, in the spirit of a committed service provider You prospect with passion, perseverance and negotiation talent You are able to correctly identify clients’ needs, potentials and opportunities and proactively contribute to the development of marketable solutions You tenaciously achieve the jointly defined objectivesYou carry out projects independently, reliably and within deadlines You love our clients and our products Your profile Perseverance, mental flexibility, social skills and a sense of responsibility are among your strengths. You have a complete professional training and several years of professional experience in a managerial position with great personal responsibility as a business leader (or similar) in the gastronomy, catering or food sector. If you are not unfamiliar with the sales sector, you are welcome as a candidate. We will help you change career paths. Your centre of life is located in the Geneva region. Your prospects The challenge ahead is to grow and gain skills through daily tasks in a dynamic environment. You will work closely with the "gastronomy & catering" sales manager as well as with the internal service. We offer you a job with great personal responsibility, good social benefits and the possibility to arrange your working hours flexibly; a company car completes our benefits package. Contact: Are you enthusiastic? If you see this mission as an opportunity and a challenge to take on, then convince us by sending your complete application file with photo, exclusively via Application Form , Human Resources, Pacovis AG, Grabenmattenstrasse 19, 5608 Stetten. Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications sent by e-mail or post, nor those from recruitment agencies.

jobs.title: Head of Events & Experiences 80-100%
jobs.description: "Swiss handball strengthens the cohesion of a modern, constantly changing society" To further develop our own events from international matches and cup finals to partner and community occasions, we are immediately or by arrangement seeking a creative, entrepreneurial and implementation-strong personality as: Head of Events & Experiences 80-100% Your area of responsibility Event development & fan experience: You consistently develop our event formats and the entire fan journey. With coherent dramaturgy, entertainment and surprising moments, you make international matches, cup finals and other SHV events special experiences before, during and after the event. Innovation & technology: You combine live experiences with digital possibilities, data and new technologies and transfer relevant impulses from other areas & industries. Event, hospitality and activation offerings: Together with marketing & sponsorship, you identify new commercial potentials and develop activatable event and hospitality offers with added value for fans, partners and the association. Planning & control: You are responsible for concepts, schedules, budgets, service providers and partners and ensure quality, cost-effectiveness and reliable implementation. Operational event implementation: You manage the preparation and on-site execution, keep an overview even in dynamic situations and pitch in where needed. Team leadership & collaboration: You lead a small event team as a player-coach and work closely with marketing & sponsorship, communication & marketing, sport and external partners. In this position, you not only shape individual events but also influence how people experience Swiss handball. You combine creative ideas with entrepreneurial thinking and operational excellence with the aim of creating enthusiasm and sustainable economic success equally. Your profile Several years of experience in the conception and implementation of complex events or live experiences – for example in sport, entertainment, festivals, brand experience or hospitality Strong sense for target groups, dramaturgy, entertainment and the details that make an event a genuine and successful experience Ability to think impact, quality and cost-effectiveness together as well as to recognise and consistently develop potentials Structured, independent and solution-oriented working style with high reliability, resilience and enjoyment of operational responsibility Openness to new technologies, data and impulses from other industries as well as courage to constructively question the status quo and try new things Inspiring, team-oriented personality who provides guidance, takes responsibility and effectively brings together different internal and external stakeholders You do not just want to manage existing processes but rethink events and implement them excellently at the same time. You do not only ask: "How have we done it so far?" but also: "How good could it become?" In doing so, you keep the needs of the fans as well as those of our teams, partners and other stakeholders in mind. Our offer We promote an open, team-oriented culture where innovation, ownership and flexibility are highly valued. You will have plenty of scope for design, short decision-making paths and the opportunity to visibly further develop the event world of Swiss handball. If you want to create live experiences that people will still talk about the next day, you will score a direct hit with us! From winter 2026, we will move: From Olten to Cham into new offices right next to the OYM College, see www.oym-college.ch . Further information about the Swiss Handball Association can be found at www.handball.ch .

jobs.title: ASAP - Marketing & Digital Communications Officer (m/f/d) 100%
jobs.description: As Marketing & Digital Communications Officer, you will support the planning and execution of multichannel marketing and communication initiatives designed to engage a global audience and strengthen brand visibility. This is a highly operational role offering exposure to content marketing, creative production, digital campaigns, webinars, podcasts and community engagement. Based in Zurich, the organization brings together experts, researchers and healthcare professionals from across the world to advance knowledge, education and collaboration within its field. To strengthen its Marketing & Communications team, our client is seeking a creative and digitally savvy marketing professional who enjoys combining content, design and digital engagement in a mission-driven environment. Manage content and campaign calendars to ensure consistent and timely messaging across all channels. Partner with internal stakeholders to deliver communication initiatives aligned with organizational priorities. Content Creation & Brand Communications Create engaging content for websites, newsletters, social media, presentations and marketing materials. Develop visual assets such as social media graphics, digital banners, infographics and promotional collateral. Ensure all communications and creative materials are aligned with brand guidelines and tone of voice. Coordinate the production of marketing materials with external agencies, designers and suppliers. Maintain organized marketing documentation, templates and digital asset libraries. Identify new communication trends, tools and best practices to enhance engagement and effectiveness. Profile Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Media, Digital Marketing or a related field Minimum 2 years of experience in marketing, communications or digital marketing Hands-on experience creating content across multiple communication channels Strong copywriting and content editing skills Experience with social media management and digital campaign execution Good knowledge of Canva and familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) Experience with email marketing tools such as Campaign Monitor, Mailchimp or similar platforms Exposure to website content management systems, ideally WordPress Knowledge of video editing tools such as Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve or equivalent Understanding of digital analytics and campaign performance reporting Excellent written and spoken English (essential) Job Offer Opportunity to contribute to an internationally recognized organization Diverse marketing role with exposure to multiple communication channels and formats Collaborative and multicultural working environment Strong learning opportunities across digital marketing, content creation and stakeholder engagement Meaningful work supporting education, science and healthcare initiatives
